# Instructions for AI agents

Translation files (`*.yml`) in this repository are generated from [rob006-software/flarum-translations](https://github.com/rob006-software/flarum-translations) -
any change made here is overwritten on the next export. **Do not open pull requests editing translation files in
this repository.**

To fix a translation, open a pull request in [rob006-software/flarum-translations](https://github.com/rob006-software/flarum-translations) instead, targeting
the `flarum2` branch (this branch of the language pack is for Flarum 2.x), and follow `AGENTS.md` of that
repository. Files map as follows (`<component>` is the same in both places, like `core` or `flarum-tags`):

- `locale/<component>.yml` -> `translations/zh_Hans/<component>.json`

If the fix is for a phrase that is missing or wrong in English, or for a bug in the extension itself, it belongs to
the extension repository, not to translations.

People who prefer to translate in the browser can use Weblate: https://weblate.rob006.net/languages/zh_Hans/flarum2/ (AI agents can't access it).

`config.js` (Day.js translations of dates: month and weekday names, date formats, relative time) is generated from
the [Day.js](https://github.com/iamkun/dayjs) locale and overwritten when a new Day.js release changes it. Fixes
belong to the Day.js repository - they are picked up here after the next Day.js release:

- `locale/config.js` -> [`src/locale/zh-cn.js`](https://github.com/iamkun/dayjs/blob/dev/src/locale/zh-cn.js)

`CHANGELOG.md`, the translation status in `README.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `.gitattributes` and `.gitignore`
are also generated. Other files (like `composer.json` or `extend.php`) are maintained in this repository as usual.
